segments.text: Page 64, Conversation. Listen and read, then say
I love this store. I haven't been here in ages.
Look at this great pen. It glows in the dark. That would be good for my nighttime writing. I wouldn't need a table lamp anymore.
Look what I found, a flying helicopter. All I have to do is use this wireless remote control to make it fly.
Hi, here you are. Tom told me that I'd find you here.
Hi. Yeah, we told Tom that we would be here today. He didn't tell us that you'd show up.
Well, that's because he didn't know. I wanted to surprise you all.
What do you think of this little gadget, Stella?
It looks peculiar. What is it?
It's a new kind of can opener. It isn't electric, though. Here's a timer also. That would come in handy.
Wow, look at this. It's a notebook that looks like a piano. It's great for someone who likes music.
That would be nice to use in school or at home.
Yes, and there's a memo holder here, too.
I want this. I can read storybooks on this tablet. It will read the words or sentences. All you have to do is point to where you want it to read.
That would help you a great deal to practice your reading skills.
